points.description: Every step is mathematically valid and the final answer is 3 (the equilateral 60-60-60, the right isosceles 45-45-90 and the 30-60-90 triangles). Any wrong step, unjustified claim that breaks the argument, or a final answer other than 3 earns 0.

rubric.notes: Single all-or-nothing mark. Full marks need a valid argument and the final answer 3. Any invalid step or a different final answer earns 0.
rubric.answer_key: Reflecting across sides must generate a tiling, so at each vertex the angle must be π/n (reflections around a vertex close up only when the angle is π/n). Angles π/a, π/b, π/c sum to π, so 1/a+1/b+1/c=1 with positive integers. The solutions are (3,3,3), (2,4,4), (2,3,6). These give the triangles 60-60-60, 45-45-90 and 30-60-90, which are pairwise dissimilar. Final answer: 3.
